products.label: A
products.reason: A multispectral space imager is a different kind of space payload from the firm’s earlier attitude and rendezvous sensors, aimed at imaging rather than navigation.

products.label: B
products.reason: B is the same rendezvous and docking sensor already offered before, just listed as a new variant.

products.label: C
products.reason: C is also the same rendezvous and docking sensor as in the prior product line, indicating a direct repeat of the existing offering.

products.label: D
products.reason: D is a star sensor, differing only by performance emphasis, so it is the same product family as the earlier star sensors and star tracker.

products.label: E
products.reason: E is a space camera, which is an imaging product rather than the attitude-control and navigation sensors the firm previously sold.
